name: Nakata Miho
source:
She used to be a popular songstress with a pure image. She retired on her own, but her husband died two years later. She now lives with her son Shuichi.

She now works as an office worker at NEK TV. She is ordered by Michiko to return as a songstress.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/utaoka/index.html]official site[/url]]
